note: Gonzales County (TX) does not zone unincorporated land; Texas counties generally cannot. The City of Gonzales publishes its Official Zoning District Map only through a Doucet/Mangomap web viewer ('Gonzales Zoning June 2026' layer). No public ArcGIS REST, WFS or file download for that layer was found in the viewer page, the city site, or ArcGIS Online/Hub searches. Nixon, Smiley and Waelder show no zoning data. Parcel data from the county CAD is not zoning districts.
